messages:
jia: Heads-up — onboarding llama5 via mistral-bridge with int4 quant. Seeing summarization quality drop vs fp32 on news-sum + conv QA. Repro steps below.

jia: Repro (local):
```
# convert + quant
python tools/convert_model.py --src=llama5 --target=mistral-bridge --out=llama5-mb/ --quant=ptq-int4 --group-size=128
# eval
./eval/harness --model ./llama5-mb/ --task news-sum --seed 42 --batch 8
```

oliver: How big is the drop? metrics?

jia: Rouge-L ~ -5 pts, BLEU -2, hallucinations up ~12% (was ~2%). Perplexity +0.55. Conversions don't crash.

sam: Quant config details? per-channel/tensor, symmetric/asym?

jia: Per-channel symmetric, group-size=128, gemma-quant-v2 via ml-convert. No rotary fudge in conversion.

natalie: Could be rotary freq/scale or head ordering mismatch — Llama5 has subtle head/rope differences. Also verify vocab offset mapping (we saw EOS +1 earlier on another convert).

jia: Diffed single-layer attention: head 7 angle scale ~1.0008 vs 1.0. KV cache offsets OK first 64 tokens.

oliver: Run logits ddiff float vs int4 first 128 tokens and top-5 diffs per step to see divergence pattern.

jia: Running: `./tools/logit_ddiff --float ./models/llama5-fp32 --quant ./llama5-mb/ --seq-len 128 --out /tmp/ddiff.json`

ci-bot: Job queued: 9587654321-ci-quant-audit.

sam: Also try group-size=64 and per-tensor quick ablation. If smaller groups help, it's quant granularity; if not, look at rotary/order.

ci-bot: Job finished. Summary: divergence begins ~token 12; top-5 mismatch rate grows 3%->18% by token 40. Heads 7 & 11 highest L2 diff. Angle scale ~1.0008 on those heads.

natalie: Tiny angle delta can amplify autoregressively. Test: apply inverse multiplier 0.9992 to rotary inv_freq and re-eval.

jia: Patch applied in conversion (adjust inv_freq). Also running ablations: group-size [64,128,256], per-channel vs per-tensor, headmap shim reorder.

ci-bot: Patch-run done. Rotary rescale 0.9992 reduced Rouge-L gap to ~1.2 pts; hallucinations down to ~4%. Group-size=64 per-channel helps less than rotary fix.

natalie: Plan: 1) add rotary-scale sanity check + auto-correct in converter, 2) run full eval across quant configs, 3) open ticket and assign. I'll create MLD-3421.

jia: Created MLD-3421: "llama5->mistral-bridge int4: rotary-scale mismatch causing quality regression" with links to ddiff and artifacts.

oliver: Root cause hypothesis: conversion missed a model-specific rotary normalization constant leading to small per-head scale error cascading. Fixes: auto-detect & adjust or embed shim mapping in conversion.

sam: I'll PR converter tests + add 10-sample smoke eval to CI. ETA EOD tomorrow.

natalie: Thanks — if CI flags anything, ping #eng-ml and me. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Closing job 9587654321-ci-quant-audit (artifacts: /ci/artifacts/9587654321/).
